description: This file implements a controller in Kubernetes that cleans up legacy service account tokens that are no longer in use, based on usage tracking and expiration policies.

classes.name: LegacySATokenCleaner
classes.description: A controller that deletes unused legacy service account tokens based on usage and age.

methods.name: NewLegacySATokenCleaner
methods.description: Creates a new instance of LegacySATokenCleaner with provided informers, client, clock, and options.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the cleaner controller, runs periodic token evaluation.

methods.name: evaluateSATokens
methods.description: Evaluates service account tokens to determine if they should be deleted based on usage and age.

methods.name: getMountedSecretNames
methods.description: Retrieves secret names mounted in pods within a namespace.

methods.name: getServiceAccount
methods.description: Fetches the ServiceAccount object associated with a secret.

methods.name: latestPossibleTrackedSinceTime
methods.description: Gets the latest timestamp from config map indicating tracking start date.
